findings.title: Corrupted intent key in sessionStorage permanently blocks demo request save until manual storage clear
findings.root_cause: SessionAttemptStorage.read() throws ZodError on malformed JSON; submit/recover then always end in requestIntentError without clearing the key.
findings.impact: User cannot save a demo request in the affected tab; message is honest but recovery requires manual sessionStorage clear or tab close.
findings.proposed_fix: Clear malformed intent on read failure (or in service on requestIntentError) and start a fresh attempt; no false success is introduced.
findings.verification: unit: malformed intent then submit succeeds with new key; e2e: inject corrupt sessionStorage value, button becomes operable.

findings.title: District sort re-evaluates every offer inside the comparator (O(n log n) full evaluations)
findings.root_cause: districtKey calls this.evaluate per comparison instead of precomputing per offer.
findings.impact: At 1000 offers measured p95 107.4 ms (crosses the project's 100 ms NFR target); at the real 20-offer catalog it is 1.6-2.3 ms and invisible.
findings.proposed_fix: Precompute districtKey per offer before sort.

findings.title: Kazakh copy has not been reviewed by a native speaker; specific candidates flagged
findings.root_cause: Editorial review NOT RUN (documented in QA_RESULTS/LOCALIZATION_REVIEW); auditor is not a native speaker.
findings.impact: Possible unnatural phrasing, e.g. step: '4 қадамның {step}-қадамы', allCategories: 'Барлық санат'.
findings.proposed_fix: Native-speaker editorial pass recorded in LOCALIZATION_REVIEW.
findings.verification: RU/KK key parity tests + screenshots after edits.

findings.title: Pilot/offline Playwright configs are Linux-only (hardcoded /usr/bin/chromium, POSIX env prefixes)
findings.impact: Cannot run pilot/offline E2E on Windows without an extra config (audit used equivalent helper configs).
findings.proposed_fix: Executable path from env + webServer.env objects.

findings.title: No rate limit on POST /api/pilot/test-login
findings.impact: Session-table growth possible on a shared host; mitigated by loopback binding and per-cookie rotation; no passwords exist.
findings.proposed_fix: Simple in-memory per-IP counter or documented acceptance for test-only.

findings.title: ResultMap and pilot footer strings are inline RU/KK instead of the i18n catalog
findings.impact: Risk of divergence when messages are edited.

findings.title: Price display logic duplicated in three components
Main JS chunk 515.49 kB exceeds Vite 500 kB advisory (gzip 153 kB)
findings.impact: First-load cacheability; critical-path gzip (~157 kB) already under project NFR limits.

findings.title: Cookie lacks Secure flag; no CSP/HSTS headers (test-only loopback stand)
findings.impact: Acceptable for loopback PILOT_TEST; must be fixed before any external exposure (already blocked by LIVE gate).

findings.title: No npm audit/SCA step in CI
npm audit/SCA and real-browser-zoom/screen-reader/physical-device checks were not performed in this audit
findings.impact: Listed in Remaining Unknowns; matches the project's own NOT RUN register.

findings.title: 39 team-attested phases have no per-phase requirements, code or test traces in the repository
findings.impact: Attestation preserved as reported status; not convertible to verified completion without per-phase evidence.
